flash_690557.description: If the State Department itself warns about Hamas financing and Russian missiles, why is Washington still debating advanced fighter aircraft for Turkey? Opinion.

flash_690556.description: Wave of antisemitic incidents in Manchester: Haredi residents’ cars vandalized days after three Jews shot with air gun.

flash_690554.description: Northern District police arrested a 39-year-old Maghar resident suspected of incitement after allegedly posting an inflammatory comment on social media following the Havat Gilad attack.

flash_690555.description: Political commentator Amit Segal addressed the reactions to the terrorist attack in which Benayahu Melet and Maj. Yuval Ezra were murdered and harshly criticized members of the Democrats party.

flash_690553.description: French security services have arrested six suspects accused of planning a terrorist attack targeting a synagogue, in the latest in a series of serious security incidents in the country.

flash_690551.description: Security officials say they are detecting a shift in Arab behavior and are warning of the possibility of a broad popular uprising following the terrorist attacks over the past week.

flash_690549.description: Minister Smotrich appeals to IDF Chief following dismissal of soldier who posted video supporting his party: 'Punishment is disproportionate. Reinstate soldier to active service.'

flash_690558.description: Seven Palestinian Arab suspects were arrested last night on suspicion of involvement in a violent incident near the Moreno farm, in the Beitar Illit area.

flash_690552.description: Mother of detained Tal Yinon Derdik speaks to Dr. Chana Katan, launching a blistering attack on authorities and revealing details of his hunger strike and harsh detention reality.

flash_690550.description: 170 members of the Religious Zionism Party's central committee will decide today among ten candidates seeking to secure a place on the party's Knesset slate.

flash_690561.description: The Government approved Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s proposal to ban the import into Israel of goods produced, entirely or in part, through forced labor.

flash_690560.description: Forty-eight years since the birth of the world’s first IVF baby, Prof. Shlomo Mashiach, pioneer of fertility medicine in Israel who helped transform global revolution in reproductive medicine into tangible hope for countless couples, passed away.

flash_690559.description: After the Dutchban on imports from Judea and Samaria, Geert Wilders, the candidate for the Dutch presidency, arrived in Israel as the guest of the head of the Samaria Council.

flash_690565.description: In the discussion, ministers demanded a stricter response and a change in the opening fire instructions.

flash_690564.description: President of Syria Ahmed al-Sharaa says that his country is working to reach a security agreement with Israel, involving additional countries, which could pave the way for comprehensive peace, without giving up the Golan.'

flash_690562.description: At the beginning of the cabinet meeting, the Prime Minister said that he would meet with President Trump in Washington.

flash_690569.description:
Beginning today, election campaign materials created or edited using artificial intelligence must carry a special disclosure label under a new law initiated by the Central Elections Committee.

Under the law, printed materials and images must display the disclosure in a size equal to at least 5% of the height of the content. In videos, the disclosure must remain visible throughout the entire recording, while in audio content it must be presented at both the beginning and the end.

flash_690568.description: Hundreds of Border Police officers arrested dozens of suspects in a major Judea and Samaria operation following the deadly terrorist attacks near Havat Gilad.

flash_690567.description: Defense Minister Israel Katz commented on the stabbing attack near Elon Moreh in which Itamar Cohen was wounded, wishing him a speedy recovery and praising the security forces for swiftly eliminating the terrorists. Katz said Palestinian terrorism has declined by more than 80% due to Israel's offensive policy but remains a threat. He vowed the IDF would continue operating throughout Judea and Samaria and said terrorism would not deter Israel from strengthening settlement and security in the region.

flash_690563.description: The Ashdod Beaches Department Deputy Director, who usually helps bathers locate their lost jewelry and objects discovered this time himself a very rare 2,500-year-old coin, originating from Cyprus. After he handed it over to the Israel Antiquities Authority, it turned out: This is the first coin of its kind ever discovered in Israel.

flash_690577.description: Netanyahu confirms to Fox News: I do intend to come to New York

flash_690576.description: A moving meeting took place between 4-year-old Yuval Kogen and the search teams that found him at Nitzanim Beach, safe and sound after 27 hours of searches.

flash_690574.description: Al Hadath reported that Iran informed senior Pakistani officials that it had not withdrawn from the negotiations but had merely suspended them, stressing the need to resume the talks from the point at which they were halted.

flash_690572.description:
A senior Iranian official told Reuters that Iran will halt its attacks as long as the United States does the same.

The official added that Tehran remains “more skeptical than optimistic" about the situation.

flash_690571.description: Zehava Shaul, the mother of Oron Shaul, was laid to rest after she passed away at age 71. Her sons, Aviram and Ofek, eulogized her and spoke about her long struggle to bring her son Oron home.

flash_690581.description:
Israeli President Isaac Herzog spoke on Sunday with King Hamad bin Isa Al Khalifa of Bahrain.

During the call, the two discussed the friendship and relations between Israel and Bahrain, as well as the importance of the US-led Abraham Accords in strengthening security, stability, and prosperity in the Middle East. The two also spoke about recent developments in the region.

Herzog noted that "Bahrain is an important country in the Middle East, and I congratulated the King on his bold leadership and vision for the region."

flash_690580.description: A spokesman for one of these search units speaks about why 4-year-old Yuval Kogan was not found faster despite the massive effort launched to locate him.

flash_690579.description: Hamam Eid was responsible for the production of UAVs for the Hamas terrorist organization in the central camps, intended to harm Israeli civilians and IDF troops.

flash_690578.description:
A senior Israeli official said the Security Cabinet approved granting immunity to the International Stabilization Force (ISF), which is expected to operate in Gaza in coordination with the IDF under President Donald Trump's 20-point plan. The official stressed that the IDF will continue holding the Yellow Line and will not withdraw until Hamas is fully disarmed and the Gaza Strip is demilitarized.

According to the official, deployment of ISF personnel will require the approval of the prime minister, defense minister, and foreign minister. The force is expected to include about 200 personnel from friendly countries, including Uganda and Morocco.

flash_690575.description: The Security Cabinet approved a pilot placing parts of Gaza under a Palestinian Arab technocratic government, backed by a multinational force and strict security screening.

flash_690573.description: US Ambassador to the UN Mike Waltz told Fox News that President Donald Trump is giving "some space" for diplomatic talks with Iran.

flash_690585.description: The chairman of the Central Elections Committee, Judge Noam Sohlberg, has ordered Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich to delete an AI-generated campaign video for being too misleading to voters.

flash_690584.description: In a Fox News interview, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said Iran's regime must either fall or be weakened enough to abandon its nuclear ambitions.

flash_690582.description: Silvain Adams met in Paris with Iranian Crown Prince Reza Pahlavi, expressed support for democratic Iran, and presented mezuzahs to the future embassies of the two countries.

flash_690589.description: President Isaac Herzog said he and Bahrain's King Hamad discussed regional challenges, advancing peace and confronting terrorism and hatred.

flash_690588.description: The Jerusalem District Attorney's Office filed a complainant's statement on Sunday with the Jerusalem Magistrates' Court against a 20-year-old Arab resident of the Silwan neighborhood for hitting a police officer with fireworks.

flash_690586.description: Following last week's terror attacks, the IDF arrested more than 130 wanted suspects and tightened security measures across Judea and Samaria.

flash_690583.description: Major Yuval Ezra, laid to rest after being murdered in the shooting attack near Havat Gilad, remembered as an influential and beloved figure by many.

flash_690593.description:
For the first time since its founding, United Arab List (Ra'am) will hold party primaries on August 22, according to a report by Channel 12.

According to the report, the party's candidate list will be chosen in a vote held separately from the conference of the Islamic Movement in Israel and without being subject to the authority of its Shura Council.

flash_690592.description: The Religious Zionist Party on Sunday evening announced the results of its primaries for the next Knesset elections, with party chairman Bezalel Smotrich retaining the top spot on the party's list.

flash_690591.description: The IDF acknowledged it knew of the unauthorized hike before the terror attack but did not stop it or provide security, according to a report.

flash_690587.description:
German media outlets are reporting that the attacker who carried out the vehicle-ramming attack during an pride event in Berlin has been killed.

According to the reports, one woman was killed in the attack and 17 other people were injured.

flash_690596.description: Static defences encourage adaptation rather than surrender. Opinion.

flash_690595.description: Haredi community leaders are launching a large-scale consumer initiative aimed at reducing the cost of living for families of Yeshiva students, following the recent economic sanctions imposed on Yeshiva students who do not report for IDF service.

flash_690590.description: Gunshots struck one Toronto bakery branch while another was vandalized, prompting a hate crime investigation and condemnation from Gideon Sa'ar.

flash_690599.description: President Trump rejects reports that he delayed massive two-week military strike on Iran over concerns about declining missile stockpiles.

flash_690598.description: Israel Police sappers neutralize a suspicious bag found in the yard of the Noam party leader’s residence. Object taken to a laboratory for further examination.

flash_690594.description: A new Kantar poll shows Likud leading with 22 seats, while Gadi Eisenkot trails by one seat and matches Netanyahu in support for prime minister, while Bennett trails.

flash_690601.description: In a closed-door meeting of the Foreign Affairs and Defense Subcommittee for Intelligence, Shin Bet Director David Zini will present data on influence operations by enemy states.

flash_690600.description:
A 21-year-old man was moderately injured after crashing his motorcycle into a guardrail in Umm al-Fahm.

A Magen David Adom (MDA) medical team treated him at the scene and evacuated him to HaEmek Hospital in Afula.

flash_690597.description: The Mayor of New York has turned the Jewish state, the Jewish people, and its democraticallye elected leader, into a collective Dreyfus. Op-ed.

flash_690628.description: The head of the Shin Bet paid his first official working visit to the Border Police National Counter-Terrorism Unit and agreed to deepen operational and technological coordination.

flash_690627.description: MK Limor Son Har-Melech hails Supreme Court's refusal to suspend the law permitting gender-separated academic programs, urges universities to begin implementing it.

flash_690625.description:
Two UAVs intercepted near Israel-Jordan border; IDF investigating.

Read more

flash_690623.description: Eight new outposts, including two in Area B, established since deadly Havat Gilad terror attack.

flash_690621.description: Archaeologists uncover first known mold used to produce First Temple-era female figurines in Jerusalem, offering direct evidence the artifacts were manufactured in the city nearly 2,600 years ago.

flash_690619.description: As the world celebrated the collapse of apartheid, communism, and Nazism, so too the day will eventually come when Islamist terrorism meets the same fate. Opinion.

flash_690642.description: Truck overturns at gas station near Sha'ar Hagai interchange, crashing into several vehicles and trapping one victim.

flash_690641.description: Tal Yinon Dardik, detained at the Russian Compound, evacuated to hospital due to low pulse rate

flash_690639.description: Marco Rubio gunning for the ICC could take an object lesson from Trump’s learning curve. The longer he sought to make Tehran’s Mullahs and Mafiosi respect his MOM (Memorandum of Misunderstanding) the more he realised they were “scum" “liars" and “sick." Op-ed.

flash_690638.description: One of the terrorists involved in stealing a weapon during the attack in Sussia has turned himself in to Israeli security forces, according to a report by Nitzan Shapira on Channel 12 News.

flash_690637.description: i24 political correspondent Guy Azriel believes that the halt in the American attacks is purely tactical: "We are far from the end of this story."

flash_690636.description: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu takes off for diplomatic visit to Washington, focusing on Iranian threat, expansion of Abraham Accords.

flash_690635.description: Two Israeli civilians cross border into Syrian territory, are located by IDF troops, returned to Israel, and detained.

flash_690634.description: New Yachin Center study warns balance of power has shifted from elected lawmakers to the Knesset's legal bureaucracy, calls for reforms to restore legislative authority to members of Knesset.

flash_690633.description: MK Moshe Saada reveals a new detail about the examination of the interrogation tactics for Nir Hefetz.

flash_690657.description: The final letter of the Torah scroll was left unfinished throughout Rom Braslavski's captivity, waiting for him to complete it after returning home.

flash_690656.description: During a condolence visit to the Melet family, Eliyahu Libman, former Kiryat Arba Council Head, says that the memorial ceremony for his brother, murdered 28 years ago by terrorists from the village of Tel, would be held shortly.

flash_690654.description: President Donald Trump said he paused expanded strikes on Iran to allow negotiations to continue, warning military action will resume if talks fail.

flash_690652.description: 60 security detainees arrested after October 7th released into Gaza Strip

flash_690650.description:
A short while ago, a drone was located in the area of Kibbutz Nahal Oz.

Following a review, it was determined to be an IDF drone.

There is no suspicion of a security incident. The incident is under review.

flash_690649.description: Security forces arrest four terrorists who were involved in the assault on an off-duty IDF soldier and the theft of his weapon over the weekend.

flash_690664.description: Unseen footage shared by CNN's Inside Politics captures a phone call between Senator Graham and Prime Minister Netanyahu, in which Graham says he will try to persuade President Trump to strike Lebanon, but Netanyahu turns down the offer.

flash_690662.description:
The Israel Airports Authority announced that flight schedules across European airspace are expected to be disrupted due to a malfunction in the Eurocontrol system in Brussels.

According to the statement, there is a high likelihood of prolonged delays affecting both departing and arriving flights in the coming hours, until the technical issue is resolved and normal operations resume.

flash_690660.description: Speaking to reporters aboard Air Force One, US President Donald Trump said there are 'some disagreements' with PM Benjamin Netanyahu, but stressed that the positions of the US and Israel on Iran are 'pretty close.'

flash_690655.description: The IDF said it eliminated an Islamic Jihad Nukhba terrorist involved in an Israeli hostage's release and a Hamas commander in separate Gaza strikes.

flash_690653.description: MK Uri Maklev slams approach of combining Torah study with military service, saying it is 'the greatest damage' facing the haredi public and 'will not be forgiven.' Rabbi Chaim Navon calls his bluff.

flash_690666.description: A report says fellow inmates tied up the Gazan doctor after accusing him of monitoring prison staff in a way they feared could bring collective punishment.

flash_690665.description: The IDF announced that, following a situational assessment, beginning tomorrow, Palestinian Arab laborers will be allowed to return to work in Jewish communities in Judea and Samaria.

flash_690661.description: Extremists distributed food and published celebratory messages after the death of Yaakov Aharon Farber, who led the Maalot Tzur haredi IDF initiative.

flash_690659.description: Trump shared criticism describing Tucker Carlson as obsessively anti-Israel and ashamed of America following his departure from the Republican Party.

flash_690670.description:
The IDF Spokesperson's Unit commented on the incident in which a teenager was struck by a Palestinian Arab vehicle near the Eli Junction, stating: "IDF forces were dispatched a short time ago to the gas station area near Eli in the Samaria Regional Brigade sector. At the location, a gathering of Israeli citizens had assembled, blocking Palestinian vehicles and hurling rocks at them."

The statement added: "Suspicions indicate that as a result of the rock-throwing, a Palestinian vehicle lost control and struck an Israeli citizen, who was evacuated to the hospital for medical treatment. The driver was detained at the scene by Judea and Samaria District Police, and an investigation into the circumstances of the incident is ongoing."

Military authorities further confirmed that the incident is not being treated as a terror attack.

flash_690669.description: 17-year-old struck by a Palestinian Arab vehicle during a protest at the Eli Junction. Magen David Adom and IDF medical personnel provide treatment and evacuate him to hospital.

flash_690667.description: The Likud Central Committee approves Netanyahu’s request for eight reserved slate spots, as well as a clause allowing sitting ministers and MKs to run in regional districts.

flash_690675.description:
A 36-year-old man was seriously injured while riding an electric scooter in Tel Aviv.

Magen David Adom (MDA) EMTs and paramedics evacuated him to Ichilov Hospital.

flash_690674.description: Four days after the fatal attack near Havat Gilad, the IDF announces that Palestinian Arab workers will be re-permitted into Israeli communities across Judea and Samaria starting on Tuesday.

flash_690672.description: Netanyahu and his entourage land in Washington

flash_690668.description: The Republicans are bringing a knife to a gunfight. The Democrats will bring a tank if gifted the chance. Opinion.

flash_690690.description: Boy George releases "We Will Dance Again," a pop-reggae track backing Israel's war effort, invoking the Nova festival attack, and criticizing pro-Palestinian Arab artists.

flash_690689.description:
The White House has released President Donald Trump's official schedule for Tuesday.

According to the schedule, Trump's meeting with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is set to take place at 11:00 a.m. Washington time (6:00 p.m. Israel time).

flash_690687.description:
The IDF Spokesperson's Unit said that, a short while ago, the Israeli Air Force intercepted a UAV in the area of the Jordan border.

The UAV did not cross into Israeli territory. The origin of the launch is under review. No sirens were sounded in accordance with protocol.

flash_690685.description: Trilateral talks between Israel, Lebanon, and the US will take place in Rome from August 4-6 to discuss border disputes and expanding southern Lebanon security zones, says a US official.

flash_690683.description: Home Front Command says incident in Kissufim has concluded

flash_690681.description: Prime Minister Netanyahu will present intelligence to President Trump showing Iran is installing centrifuges at Pickaxe Mountain and breaking ceasefire promises, reports The New York Post.
